key.name: quick-note
key.description: Opens an empty note right away.

key.name: project-note
key.summary: New note for the active project
key.description: Opens a note tagged with the project of the focused terminal, or of the last project opened.

key.name: picker
key.summary: Quick picker for projects, apps and groups
key.description: Search and open without the mouse.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Command that opens a terminal in a project folder; {dir} is replaced by the folder. Empty: detect automatically.

key.name: browser-command
key.description: Command that opens the project documentation in a new window; {url} is replaced by the address. Empty: use the default browser.

key.name: notes-command
key.description: Command of the notes app. Empty: use lovycairn-notes if it is installed.

key.name: notes-dir
key.description: Folder where notes are stored. Empty: Notes in the home folder.

key.name: notes-integration
key.summary: Show collapsed notes on the desktop
key.description: Draws collapsed notes as sticky icons on the desktop and remembers where note windows were.

key.name: compat-notified
key.description: Internal: avoids showing the same notice at every login.
